Timeline Preview

1943: McCulloch-Pitts artificial neuron
1950: Turing Test proposed
1956: Dartmouth Conference - "AI" coined
1957: Perceptron invented (Rosenblatt)
1969: "Perceptrons" book - First AI Winter trigger
1986: Backpropagation revival
1997: Deep Blue beats Kasparov
2012: AlexNet - Deep Learning revolution
2017: "Attention Is All You Need" - Transformer
2022: ChatGPT public release
2024: Claude, GPT-4, Gemini, open-source explosion

Key Personalities

NameContribution
Alan TuringTuring Test, theoretical foundations
John McCarthyCoined "AI", invented Lisp
Marvin MinskyNeural nets, frames, AI symbolism

Andrej KarpathyNeural network education, Tesla AI
Ilya SutskeverAlexNet, GPT, scaling laws

Critical Lessons

  • AI Winters: Overpromising leads to funding collapse
  • The Bitter Lesson: General methods + compute beat hand-crafted features
  • Why Deep Learning Won: Data + compute + algorithms at scale
